entry.title: Crusoe Raises Over $3 Billion in Funding at $30 Billion Valuation
entry.summary: Crusoe, a cloud-computing provider and data center developer doing business with OpenAI, Microsoft Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc., has raised over $3 billion in a funding round that values the startup at roughly $30 billion, according to people familiar with the situation.

entry.title: Broadcom Forecasts Boom in AI Chip Sales
entry.summary: Broadcom predicted a surge in artificial intelligence chip sales over the next two years, helping renew optimism that it can challenge Nvidia’s dominance in the lucrative market. The company also is on track to top earnings of $30 a share in fiscal 2028, outpacing Wall Street estimates. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Matt Bloxham has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Beyond the Model: The Unlikely Architecture of the AI Winners
entry.summary: There is no single "winner" of the AI space. While labs like OpenAI and Anthropic fight over the model layer, the real, durable victory is happening in the plumbing. Compute (NVIDIA), inference (vLLM), and economic routing (Stripe's acquisition of OpenRouter) are proving far more valuable and stable than the AI models themselves, positioning infrastructure as the true king of the AI boom.Read All

entry.title: Tencent-Backed Enflame’s IPO Draws 4,073 Times Retail Demand
entry.summary: The initial public offering of Shanghai Enflame Technology Co., a company backed by Tencent Holdings Ltd., drew strong demand from retail investors, as the last of the so-called “four little dragons” of leading Chinese artificial intelligence chipmakers taps the public market.

entry.title: Lyte Closes $165 Million Round, Bringing AI Startup's Valuation to $1.6 Billion
entry.summary: Lyte, a fast-growing robotics and artificial intelligence startup from top members of Apple Inc.'s Face ID team, has secured about $165 million in a new funding round that more than triples the company’s valuation to $1.6 billion.

entry.title: Palo Alto Networks Tops Profit Outlook on AI Security Demand
entry.summary: The cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks Inc. issued a profit outlook for the year that exceeded Wall Street’s expectations, fueled by corporate demand for stronger defenses against advancing artificial intelligence systems.
